definitions.full: H4241. michyah מִחְיָה noun feminine preservation of life, sustenance , ׳מ Gen 45:5 4 t.; construct מִחְיַת Lev 13:10 , 24 ; suffix מִחְיָתֶ֑ךָ Judg 17:10 ; — 1 preservation of life Gen 45:5 (E), 2Chr 14:12 . 2 sustenance Judg 6:4 ; 17:10 . 3 reviving , Ezra 9:8-9 ,. 4 the quick ( בָּשָׂר ) מִחְיַת the quick (or raw spot) of the flesh Lev 13:10 , 24 (P).
